rootCauses: Programmatic carousel animation completion was handled as a fresh user track selection, feeding navigation back into playback.
FIFO selection/source resolution applied obsolete requests and blocked Pause behind network lookup.
Store queue replacement and autoplay were separate operations, allowing delayed Play to override Pause.
Stale native event payloads could overwrite current selection; toggle did not consistently honor buffering play intent.
changes: Coalesce rapid selection bursts (70 ms); accumulate relative intent and commit only the latest valid target.
Resolve catalog sources outside native mutation lock; retain ordered native mutations and invalidate stale callbacks.
Preserve Play/Pause intent and audio/video ownership; publish coherent native snapshots and committed queues.
Accept carousel navigation only from completed current human gestures.
Remove normal visible status captions from audio/video controls, retaining accessible feedback and visible errors.

focusedTests.scope: Native-contract mocks and captured provider fixtures; not device playback proof

android.finding: Old installed APK had an empty stopped native queue. Six real UI taps were recorded; they cannot verify the source fix or establish a playback race reproduction.

remaining: Updated source is not in the installed APK. Actual fixed-build rapid taps, audiovisual continuity and accessibility feedback require Android acceptance.
